caption: A desk fan with its switch already on is plugged into a socket, and the blades start turning.

sa.check: Its plug is inserted into a socket.
The blades start turning after the plug goes in.
The fan is still before it is plugged in.
Plugging in comes first, spinning after.

pc.expect: The blades begin to turn when the plug seats in the socket, and only then.
pc.fail: The plug is in and the blades stay still; or the blades start before the plug reaches the socket; or they start with the plug lying loose.

pc.expect: Before the plug is in the blades are still; after, they speed up and settle to a steady spin; they do not stop or reverse on their own.
pc.fail: The blades spin while unplugged; or turn slowly by themselves before plugging; or stop and restart with the plug in; or reverse direction.

pc.expect: The blades spin about the hub as one piece with a smooth speed-up; the head may oscillate if built to.
pc.fail: The blades wobble off the hub; or the spin jumps abruptly between fast and still; or blades move independently of each other.

pc.expect: Light items in front of the fan flutter in the airflow once the blades spin and are still before.
pc.fail: Ribbons or paper flutter before the blades turn; or nothing in front moves while the fan blows; or the flutter blows toward the fan.
pc.precondition: Light items such as paper, ribbons or hair are in front of the fan.

pc.expect: One fan with a fixed number of blades, one plug and cord; the plug enters the socket rather than passing into the wall.
pc.fail: Blades appear or vanish; or the fan duplicates; or the plug passes through the wall beside the socket; or the cord detaches or splits.

pc.expect: The fan's colour, the desk and the socket stay the same.
pc.fail: The fan changes colour; or the cage changes pattern; or the socket moves along the wall.
